# Persistent State {#sec-memory-state}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_What should an agent remember, where should that state live, and when should it be forgotten?_

## Planned Coverage

- Working, episodic, semantic, and procedural state
- Durable state schemas and ownership
- Retrieval, consolidation, invalidation, and forgetting
- Concurrency, consistency, and isolation for shared state
- Privacy, retention, and deletion obligations

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to choose a memory architecture from workload requirements instead of treating memory as an undifferentiated vector store.
